english: Every unit you recruit takes resources from your stores by its type and worth (cavalry and monsters take mounts, infantry and war machines take war materials, the finest also take your rare resource). What the stores lack is paid in your race's own currency where it has one. A recruit whose resources are still short arrives understrength, unless Gold pays for recruits is ticked. Vampire Counts and Vampire Coast recruits take nothing. Off: recruiting takes nothing.
